02 / COMPOSITOR

Surface recipe

Bitmap layers / PBR inputs

Import matching maps. Color uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metallic, AO, height and mask are linear data. Normal format: tangent-space OpenGL (+Y). Files are embedded in exported recipes.

Apply to ship stores this material for the Shipyard preview. Credits retain deterministic seeded finishes. Exported JSON includes bitmap layers so the recipe can be reconstructed.
